items.source:
If multiple jobs are found, a job name to execute on startup can be supplied by the
User with : spring.batch.job.name=job1. In this case the Runner will first
find jobs registered as Beans, then those in the existing JobRegistry.
items.translation: 如果找到多个作业，用户可以通过 `spring.batch.job.name=job1` 指定在启动时执行的作业名称。在这种情况下，Runner 将首先查找注册为 Bean 的作业，然后查找现有 JobRegistry 中的作业。
